title: CSK vs LSG: Chepauk Becomes Playoff Battleground
excerpt: Chennai Super Kings host a desperate Lucknow Super Giants in a must-win IPL 2026 afternoon clash at MA Chidambaram Stadium.
body:
Chennai Super Kings host Lucknow Super Giants in Match 53 of IPL 2026 today, Sunday May 10, at the MA Chidambaram Stadium with a 3:30 PM IST start — and for CSK, every run matters. Chennai will take on Lucknow in a quest to book a place in the playoffs of IPL 2026 at the MA Chidambaram Stadium on Sunday, May 10. The stakes could not be sharper — or the contrast more vivid.

**Where Each Side Stands:**
After losing their first three matches, CSK went on to win five out of the last seven matches to keep themselves in the playoff race, currently placed at 6th spot with 10 points from 5 wins and 5 losses in 10 matches. Sanju Samson has been the mainstay of CSK's batting with 402 runs in 10 matches at an average of 57.43. Lucknow, by contrast, arrive at Chepauk with nothing but pride. Lucknow Super Giants continue to battle through a difficult campaign and remain at the bottom of the standings with only three wins from ten games.

**The Spin Trap and the Dhoni Watch:**
For everyone demanding better balance between bat and ball in IPL 2026, Sunday's encounter is must-see — two of the season's best bowling attacks face off, even if neither are in the top four. Chepauk's slow and dry afternoon conditions remove LSG's most potent weapon — pace — while amplifying CSK's greatest strength — spin. And hovering over it all is the familiar question: MS Dhoni is yet to play any match due to a persistent calf injury sustained before the season, and while he has trained in the nets, he has not featured in the playing XI so far. With only four games left in the league stage, if IPL 2026 is meant to be his farewell, time is running out.

**What to Watch Next:**
CSK need to win at least three out of their last four matches to qualify for the playoffs, making this home fixture against a wounded LSG side one of the defining moments of their season.
